simple.meaning: סוֹד (çôwd) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a session , i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy , consultation , a secret.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: a session , i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy , consultation , a secret
definitions.full: H5475. sod סוֺד noun [masculine] council, counsel ; — ׳ס absolute Prov 11:13 +; construct Jer 6:11 +; suffix סוֺדִי 23:22 ; Job 19:19 ; סוֺדוֺ Amos 3:7 ; Prov 3:32 ; סֹדָם Gen 49:6 ; — 1 council , in familiar conversation; — a. divan or circle of familiar friends, ׳ס בַּחוּרִים Jer 6:11 , ׳מ משׂחקים 15:17 ; סוֺדִ ׳מְתֵי Job 19:19 men of my intimate circle ; (י בסוד ׅ׳עמד Jer 23:18 , 22 in the intimate circle of ׳י ; אלוה בסוד Job 15:8 ; in bad sense, ׳ס מְרֵעִים Psa 64:3 . b. assembly, company , ׳ס יְשָׁרִים Psa 111:1 (|| עֵדָה ; עמי סוֺד Ezek 13:9 ; ׳ס קדשׁים Psa 89:8 (of angels); in bad sense, בא בסוד Gen 49:6 (|| קהל ). 2 counsel , taken by those in familiar conversation: a. counsel itself, סוד באין מחשׁבות Prov 15:22 thoughts without counsel ; of intimate friendship, Psa 55:15 סוֺד נַמְתִּיק ; in bad sense, of crafty plotting 83:4 סוֺד יַעֲרִימוּ b. secret counsel , which may be revealed ( גלה ), Amos 3:7 ; Prov 11:13 ; 20:19 ; 25:9 . c. familiar converse with God, intimacy , ס ׳ליראיו ׳י Psa 25:14 intimacy with ׳י have those who fear him (|| ברית ), סודוֺ אתיֿשׁרים Prov 3:22 with the upright is his intimacy ; here also Job 29:4 (si vera lectio) Di De and others; Siegf Du compare Buhl Lex בְּסֹךְ when Eloah sheltered my tent.

occurrences.englishText: My soul, don’t come into their council.
Have you heard the secret counsel of God?
All my familiar friends abhor me.
as I was in my prime,
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him.
Let death come suddenly on them.
who sharpen their tongue like a sword,
“Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation,
Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you?
Praise Yah!* Psalm 111 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise Yah!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh,
One who brings gossip betrays a confidence,
Where there is no counsel, plans fail;
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets;
Debate your case with your neighbor,
Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in.
I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice.
For who has stood in the council of Yahweh,
But if they had stood in my council,

“My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”
Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing,
